Caliente's exact three-way +220 is below approximately +250 fair after including the +1400 draw, while the aggregator-only Pinnacle +257 remains below roughly +274 paired fair. No current quote offers a justified edge.

The same preview supplies the decisive restraint: Canelo has not stopped an opponent in almost five years. BetUS's complete five-outcome method board normalizes Canelo by KO/TKO/DQ near +478 fair, making direct +400 too short; Sportsbet's roughly +420 and Caliente's +350 also fail the threshold. The tactical path is real, but the current market pays as though the old stoppage version of Canelo is more certain than the evidence supports.
